unresolved_findings.judge_assessment: Refutation accepted. Both cited schema.rb lines show unbounded Stripe id strings; the spec's interface says 'string'. Convention beats the nit. Reviewer withdrew with a reason.

deterministic_checks.detail: all automated criteria map to passing tests

residual_risks: Smart Retries must be enabled in the Stripe dashboard before launch; the code is inert without it (rollout step 3 in the spec).
invoice.payment_action_required is ignored by design (spec minor issue SR-1 accepted at Gate 2); if 3DS challenges rise, failures will look like plain declines in payment_attempts.
summary_for_human: Adds a payment_attempts table and handles Stripe invoice.payment_failed / invoice.paid webhooks to record every attempt, publishing billing.retries_exhausted when Stripe gives up. Review round 1 found a real concurrency bug (F-1: duplicate webhook deliveries raced and returned 500) and a correctness bug (F-2: voided invoices were treated as final failures); both were fixed with new tests and I re-ran the reviewer's 20-thread probe myself: 20/20 clean. One nit (F-4) was refuted on project convention and withdrawn. All 8 acceptance criteria are met with located tests; the orchestrator's own run of the test plan passed (34 examples). Nothing needs a decision from you. Read first: app/models/payment_attempt.rb (the idempotent insert) and the two new handler branches at stripe_webhook_handler.rb:36-49. Then the migration, which is additive only.
